content: Ports-and-Adapters (Hexagonal) architecture is the established pattern for a TypeScript core reusable across Node CLI and browser. Core owns 'port' interfaces (driven: e.g. ArchiveReader, LineSource; driving: use-case methods). Adapters live outside the core and implement them; a single composition/container file wires both sides. The arrow of dependency points INTO the hexagon: the core imports no npm/platform packages (no fs, no readline, no fflate). Driving adapters (CLI, future web route) call core use-cases; driven adapters (Node fs/readline/fflate, future browser DecompressionStream) satisfy core interfaces. This is exactly the decoupling the project needs.
